items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 70:1
items.html: The drawing of the vessels of ZA is attributed to the Partzuf of Keter of AK, for Keter is the phase of the principal and the root, from which all the discernments are drawn. And likewise, the phase of the AA of Atzilut is considered to receive from the phase of the AA of AK, for every phase in Atzilut receives from the phase opposite it in AK.
